com.webforj.component.accordion.Accordio.title: Accordion
com.webforj.component.accordion.Accordio.content: Group collapsible panels with the Accordion and AccordionPanel components to toggle visibility and coordinate expand or collapse behavior.

com.webforj.component.alert.Alert.title: Alert
com.webforj.component.alert.Alert.content: Display contextual feedback messages with the Alert component, including themes, expanses, dismissible close events, and rich content.

com.webforj.component.avatar.Avatar.title: Avatar
com.webforj.component.avatar.Avatar.content: Represent users with the Avatar component, showing profile images, auto-computed initials, custom initials, or icons for identification.

com.webforj.component.badge.Badge.title: Badge
com.webforj.component.badge.Badge.content: Surface counts, statuses, or short labels with the Badge component, including themes, slotted icons, and attachment to buttons or tabs.

com.webforj.component.desktopnotificatio.title: DesktopNotification
com.webforj.component.desktopnotificatio.content: Send native OS notifications outside the browser window with the DesktopNotification component for real-time messages, alerts, and status changes.

com.webforj.component.dialog.Dialog.title: Dialog
com.webforj.component.dialog.Dialog.content: Open modal popups with the Dialog component, including header, content, and footer sections, backdrop blur, and configurable close behavior.

com.webforj.component.drawer.Drawer.title: Drawer
com.webforj.component.drawer.Drawer.content: Slide panels in from any screen edge with the Drawer component, ideal for side navigation, filter menus, settings, and stackable popovers.

com.webforj.component.field.ColorField.title: ColorField
com.webforj.component.field.ColorField.content: A component that provides a default browser-based color picker, allowing users to select a color from an input field.

com.webforj.component.field.DateField.title: DateField
com.webforj.component.field.DateField.content: A component that provides a default browser-based date picker for selecting a date through an input field.

com.webforj.component.field.DateTimeFiel.title: DateTimeField
com.webforj.component.field.DateTimeFiel.content: A component that provides a default browser-based date and time picker for selecting both date and time through a single input field.

com.webforj.component.field.MaskedDateFi.title: MaskedDateField
com.webforj.component.field.MaskedDateFi.content: Capture localized date input with the MaskedDateField, applying configurable masks, format indicators, parsing rules, and validation.

com.webforj.component.field.MaskedNumber.title: MaskedNumberField
com.webforj.component.field.MaskedNumber.content: Format numeric input with the MaskedNumberField using configurable mask characters, grouping, decimal separators, and locale settings.

com.webforj.component.field.MaskedTextFi.title: MaskedTextField
com.webforj.component.field.MaskedTextFi.content: Enforce formatted text entry with the MaskedTextField, supporting mask characters for digits, letters, and literals for IDs and codes.

com.webforj.component.field.MaskedTimeFi.title: MaskedTimeField
com.webforj.component.field.MaskedTimeFi.content: Capture time input with the MaskedTimeField, applying 12 or 24-hour masks, format indicators, locale-aware parsing, and validation.

com.webforj.component.field.NumberField.title: NumberField
com.webforj.component.field.NumberField.content: A component that provides a default browser-based input field for entering numeric values, with built-in controls for incrementing or decrementing the value.

com.webforj.component.field.PasswordFiel.title: PasswordField
com.webforj.component.field.PasswordFiel.content: A single-line input component for securely entering and masking password data.

com.webforj.component.field.TextArea.title: TextArea
com.webforj.component.field.TextArea.content: Capture multi-line input with the TextArea component, including paragraph management, character limits, wrapping, and validation.

com.webforj.component.field.TextField.title: TextField
com.webforj.component.field.TextField.content: A single-line input component for entering and editing text data.

com.webforj.component.field.TimeField.title: TimeField
com.webforj.component.field.TimeField.content: A component that provides a default browser-based time picker for selecting a time value through an input field.

com.webforj.component.googlecharts.Googl.title: Google Charts
com.webforj.component.googlecharts.Googl.content: Render bar, line, pie, geo, and other Google Charts in webforJ using the GoogleChart component with a typed Java options map and data API.

com.webforj.component.icons.Icon.title: Icon
com.webforj.component.icons.Icon.content: Render scalable SVG icons with the Icon component from Tabler, Feather, Font Awesome, or custom pools loaded on demand from a CDN.

com.webforj.component.infinitescroll.Inf.title: InfiniteScroll
com.webforj.component.infinitescroll.Inf.content: Load more content as users scroll with the InfiniteScroll component, emitting scroll events and showing a customizable loading spinner.

com.webforj.component.layout.applayout.A.title: AppLayout
com.webforj.component.layout.applayout.A.content: Build dashboards and admin shells with the AppLayout component, providing a fixed header, footer, sliding drawer, and scrollable content area.

com.webforj.component.layout.appnav.AppN.title: AppNav
com.webforj.component.layout.appnav.AppN.content: Build hierarchical side navigation menus with AppNav and AppNavItem, linking to routes, registered views, or external URLs.

com.webforj.component.layout.columnslayo.title: ColumnsLayout
com.webforj.component.layout.columnslayo.content: Arrange child components into a responsive multi-column grid with the ColumnsLayout component using configurable breakpoints and alignment.

com.webforj.component.layout.flexlayout..title: FlexLayout
com.webforj.component.layout.flexlayout..content: Arrange children in rows or columns with the FlexLayout component, controlling direction, justification, alignment, wrapping, and growth.

com.webforj.component.layout.splitter.Sp.title: Splitter
com.webforj.component.layout.splitter.Sp.content: Divide a layout into resizable master and detail panels with the Splitter component, with min and max sizes and orientation control.

com.webforj.component.layout.toolbar.Too.title: Toolbar
com.webforj.component.layout.toolbar.Too.content: Lay out action controls with the Toolbar component, placing components into Start, Title, Content, and End slots with compact mode.

com.webforj.component.list.ChoiceBox.title: ChoiceBox
com.webforj.component.list.ChoiceBox.content: Pick a single value from a fixed set with the ChoiceBox dropdown, including dropdown type styling, max row count, and keyboard navigation.

com.webforj.component.list.ComboBox.title: ComboBox
com.webforj.component.list.ComboBox.content: Combine a dropdown list with a text input in the ComboBox to let users select preset items or type custom values with placeholder support.

com.webforj.component.list.ListBox.title: ListBox
com.webforj.component.list.ListBox.content: Show a scrollable, always-visible list with the ListBox component, supporting single or multiple selection and keyboard navigation.

com.webforj.component.loading.Loading.title: Loading
com.webforj.component.loading.Loading.content: Overlay a parent container with the Loading component to block interaction during async tasks, with backdrop and spinner customization.

com.webforj.component.login.Login.title: Login
com.webforj.component.login.Login.content: Display an authentication dialog with the Login component, handling submission, validation, custom fields, and form action URLs.

com.webforj.component.markdown.MarkdownV.title: MarkdownViewer
com.webforj.component.markdown.MarkdownV.content: Render markdown as HTML with the MarkdownViewer component, supporting append, auto-scroll, and progressive typewriter rendering.

com.webforj.component.navigator.Navigato.title: Navigator
com.webforj.component.navigator.Navigato.content: Add pagination controls with the Navigator component, binding to a Paginator or Repository to drive page size, navigation, and labels.

com.webforj.component.optiondialog.Confi.title: Confirm
com.webforj.component.optiondialog.Confi.content: Show a blocking ConfirmDialog with up to three options, configurable button sets, message types, and timeout behavior.

com.webforj.component.optiondialog.FileC.title: File Chooser
com.webforj.component.optiondialog.FileC.content: Open a blocking FileChooserDialog to let users pick files or directories from the server, with selection modes and initial paths.

com.webforj.component.optiondialog.FileS.title: File Save
com.webforj.component.optiondialog.FileS.content: Prompt users for a save location with the FileSaveDialog, configuring initial path, default filename, and overwrite behavior.

com.webforj.component.optiondialog.FileU.title: File Upload
com.webforj.component.optiondialog.FileU.content: Capture client uploads with the FileUploadDialog, returning an UploadedFile that you can filter, move, and process server-side.

com.webforj.component.optiondialog.Input.title: Input Dialog
com.webforj.component.optiondialog.Input.content: Prompt users for text, numbers, dates, colors, or other typed values with the modal InputDialog and message-type styling.

com.webforj.component.optiondialog.Messa.title: Message
com.webforj.component.optiondialog.Messa.content: Show a blocking MessageDialog with an OK button, configurable message types, alignment, blur, and timeout.

com.webforj.component.optioninput.CheckB.title: CheckBox
com.webforj.component.optioninput.CheckB.content: Toggle individual settings or pick multiple options with the CheckBox component, supporting text positioning and an indeterminate state.

com.webforj.component.optioninput.RadioB.title: RadioButton
com.webforj.component.optioninput.RadioB.content: Add a single-choice RadioButton with text positioning, activation modes, and grouping for mutually exclusive selections.

com.webforj.component.optioninput.RadioB.title: RadioButtonGroup
com.webforj.component.optioninput.RadioB.content: Coordinate mutually exclusive RadioButton selections with RadioButtonGroup, including nested containers and dynamic membership.

com.webforj.component.refresher.Refreshe.title: Refresher
com.webforj.component.refresher.Refreshe.content: Enable pull-to-refresh on scrollable areas with the Refresher component, with pull, release, and refreshing states and i18n labels.

com.webforj.component.slider.Slider.title: Slider
com.webforj.component.slider.Slider.content: Let users pick a numeric value with the Slider component, with configurable range, step, tick marks, labels, and orientation.

com.webforj.component.spinner.Spinner.title: Spinner
com.webforj.component.spinner.Spinner.content: Indicate background activity with the Spinner component, configuring theme, expanse, rotation speed, and pause or resume.

com.webforj.component.tabbedpane.TabbedP.title: TabbedPane
com.webforj.component.tabbedpane.TabbedP.content: Organize content into switchable Tab sections with the TabbedPane component, supporting icons, keys, and customizable tab properties.

com.webforj.component.table.Column.title: Columns
com.webforj.component.table.Column.content: Define Table columns with labels, value providers, visibility, navigability, sizing, and user-interaction events.

com.webforj.component.table.Table.title: Table
com.webforj.component.table.Table.content: Display tabular data with the Table component, binding entity classes to a Repository to populate columns and render rows.

com.webforj.component.table.renderer.But.title: Button
com.webforj.component.table.renderer.But.content: Trigger click actions in webforJ with the Button component, including themes, expanses, prefix and suffix icons, and disabled state.

com.webforj.component.table.renderer.Pro.title: ProgressBar
com.webforj.component.table.renderer.Pro.content: Visualize task completion with the ProgressBar component, supporting determinate and indeterminate modes, orientation, and themes.

com.webforj.component.table.renderer.Ren.title: Rendering
com.webforj.component.table.renderer.Ren.content: Transform Table cells into text, badges, icons, links, or custom HTML with built-in renderers and the setRenderer method.

com.webforj.component.terminal.Terminal.title: Terminal
com.webforj.component.terminal.Terminal.content: Embed an interactive terminal emulator with the Terminal component for shells, dashboards, debug consoles, and remote access tools.

com.webforj.component.toast.Toast.title: Toast
com.webforj.component.toast.Toast.content: Show transient notifications with the Toast component, configuring duration, theme, and placement via Toast.show or open.

com.webforj.component.tree.Tree.title: Tree
com.webforj.component.tree.Tree.content: Display hierarchical data with the Tree component, using TreeNode parent-child links, expand or collapse, icons, and selection.

com.webforj.component.upload.Upload.title: Upload
com.webforj.component.upload.Upload.content: Select and upload one or more files from the local machine with the Upload component using drag-and-drop, filters, and per-file or batch event tracking.
